title: A rectangle placed by its transform
concept: How ItemTransform positions a shape whose PathGeometry is authored at the origin.

annotations.note: ItemTransform is the 6-tuple a b c d tx ty. Here a=d=1, b=c=0 (no scale/rotate) and tx=150 ty=200 slide the rectangle 150pt right and 200pt down into the page.
The four PathPointType anchors are authored in the rectangle's own inner coords, starting at 0 0. The shape lives at the origin; the transform does the placing.
Anchor is x y. 0 120 is x=0, y=120 — y grows downward, so this is the lower-left corner.
